description: RFP Response Checker is a read-only service that extracts explicitly stated requirements from user-provided RFP text and checks whether a supplied response addresses each requirement. It returns evidence-linked results showing addressed, partially addressed, and not addressed items without inventing unstated requirements.

defaultPrompt: Extract all explicitly stated requirements from this RFP.
Check whether our response covers every explicit RFP requirement.
Show addressed, partially addressed, and missing RFP requirements with evidence.
